name: New Jersey

response.rule_text: Custodian must act not later than seven business days after receiving the request (N.J.S.A. 47:1A-5(i)(1)); failure to respond is deemed a denial.

fees.labor_rule: Special service charge allowed for extraordinary time/effort; must be reasonable and based on direct cost; requester may object first.
fees.copy_rule: $0.05 per letter-size page, $0.07 per legal-size or larger; electronic records free except actual supply cost.
fees.waiver_rule: No fee for crime victim's copies of records they are entitled to.
fees.late_penalty: Knowing and willful violation: civil penalty $1,000 / $2,500 / $5,000 (47:1A-11); prevailing requester gets attorney fees.

residency.rule_text: OPRA refers to access by citizens of this State (47:1A-1); RCFP says the Attorney General's Office takes the position OPRA does not bar access by residents of other states.

appeal.body: Government Records Council or Superior Court
appeal.rule_text: Requester may file with the GRC within 60 calendar days of denial (N.J.A.C. 5:105-2.1) or sue in Superior Court (47:1A-6); court action 45 days per Mason v. Hoboken.

format_rule: Records provided in the medium requested if agency maintains them in that medium (47:1A-5(d)); requests must be in writing (47:1A-5(g)).
notes: Fetched in three 100k chunks. Governor partly covered (executive privilege excluded, EO 26); legislature partly excluded (constituent info, member memoranda); universities have listed exclusions; school districts not separately addressed, so covers fields left null rather than boolean. Residency: statutory text says citizens, AG does not enforce. Common-law access preserved. Court filing: 45 days per Mason (unclear whether it applies to GRC).
